For converse fix support direction u and form transverse-large round frusta with top/bottom heights a=h_K(u),−b=−h_K(−u). Their centroid moves continuously from (a−nb)/(n+1) to (na−b)/(n+1); choose interior centroids tending to min(a/(n+1),(na−b)/(n+1)), maintaining (n+1)cen(B) on the contained axis, giving exact sharp support equal to max(na,a+b)/(n+1). Arbitrary K fits with sufficiently large transverse radii, proving the infinite family equality without finite extrapolation. Independent symbolic moment calculations for dimensions 2 through 7 and rational triangle hull computation support the frustum limits/nonagon 7/9 statement. No single B optimizer asserted.
